text:
Which safety precautions must be taken when using a source of gamma radiation?
1
Reduce the distance between the source and the person.
2
Reduce the time of exposure to the radiation.
3
Use a suitable shielding material between the source and the person.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Physics
